arguments.sql:
WITH link_endpoints AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y-%m', l.CreationDate) AS month,
        l.LinkTypeId,
        l.PostId,
        l.RelatedPostId,
        src.Id AS source_match,
        dst.Id AS target_match,
        src.AnswerCount AS source_answers,
        dst.AnswerCount AS target_answers,
        src.Body AS source_body,
        dst.Body AS target_body
    FROM main.postLinks AS l
    LEFT JOIN main.posts AS src ON src.Id = l.PostId
    LEFT JOIN main.posts AS dst ON dst.Id = l.RelatedPostId
    WHERE l.CreationDate >= '2010-01-01'
      AND l.CreationDate < '2011-01-01'
)
SELECT
    month,
    LinkTypeId,
    COUNT(*) AS link_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE source_match IS NULL OR target_match IS NULL) AS missing_endpoints,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE source_answers IS NULL OR target_answers IS NULL) AS missing_answer_counts,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE source_body LIKE '%href="%/questions/' || RelatedPostId || '/%'
           OR source_body LIKE '%href="%/questions/' || RelatedPostId || '"%'
           OR source_body LIKE '%href="%/q/' || RelatedPostId || '/%'
           OR source_body LIKE '%href="%/q/' || RelatedPostId || '"%'
    ) AS post_body_references_related,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE target_body LIKE '%href="%/questions/' || PostId || '/%'
           OR target_body LIKE '%href="%/questions/' || PostId || '"%'
           OR target_body LIKE '%href="%/q/' || PostId || '/%'
           OR target_body LIKE '%href="%/q/' || PostId || '"%'
    ) AS related_body_references_post,
    COUNT(DISTINCT PostId) FILTER (WHERE source_answers <= 2) AS qualifying_post_ids,
    COUNT(DISTINCT RelatedPostId) FILTER (WHERE target_answers <= 2) AS qualifying_related_post_ids,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE target_answers <= 2) AS qualifying_related_link_rows
FROM link_endpoints
GROUP BY month, LinkTypeId
ORDER BY month, LinkTypeId

WITH RECURSIVE months(month_start) AS (
    SELECT '2010-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date(month_start, '+1 month')
    FROM months
    WHERE month_start < '2010-12-01'
),
monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT
        date(l.CreationDate, 'start of month') AS month_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.Id) AS post_count
    FROM main.postLinks AS l
    JOIN main.posts AS p ON p.Id = l.RelatedPostId
    WHERE l.CreationDate >= '2010-01-01'
      AND l.CreationDate < '2011-01-01'
      AND p.AnswerCount <= 2
    GROUP BY date(l.CreationDate, 'start of month')
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(c.post_count, 0)), 2) AS average_monthly_posts
FROM months AS m
LEFT JOIN monthly_counts AS c ON c.month_start = m.month_start
LIMIT 1
